question: Does the pre-download-frozen fifth family supply three complementary target views on each side and an admitted same-scene sibling before any RGB or model access?

selection.memory: Greedily add maximum newly visible target vertices; ties use larger short-side fraction, higher depth-visible ratio, then earlier frame.
selection.sibling: Record the first different door or doorframe instance with an admitted view; its appearance is forbidden from target-only ranking.

next_action.evaluable: Freeze three target views per side, then run the unchanged at-most-three proposal set contributed by layer-18 local, equal semantic/local fusion, and nearest reference-scale mixture once.
next_action.not_evaluable: Retain the source receipt and do not open RGB or call GroundingDINO, DINOv2 or SAM2 for this family.

forbidden_after_freeze: change family, target, view rules, memory budget or sibling rule
change full-plus-40-percent proposal windows, layer-18 representation, the three proposal contributors, their scores, deduplication, IoU gate or maximum set size
use sibling appearance or query truth in hypothesis generation
reinterpret source scarcity as algorithm failure
claim_boundary: This source gate can establish only whether the fifth new family supplies three-view target memory and a sibling control. It is not algorithm evidence, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, referent binding, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
